source_quote:
You initialize prefill graph here?
But use decodes graph here?
I think this is my fault. Let me think, should we view it as prefill or decode?
You're right. It should indeed be viewed as a decode.
Prefill is `self.model.precompute_and_store_context_kv`.
Following vllm, this function should be named as `_build_draft_attn_metadatas`.
I think my old naming `build_draft_attn_metadatas` is out-of-date.
But perhaps vllm will be changed again? I think maybe it is necessary to add a comment to mark this.
Change the name of this function to indicate that the results have been sorted.

rule.description: 在 speculative decoding 的 graph 管理中，prefill 和 decode 的命名应准确反映其语义。DFlash 并行 drafting 应视为 decode 路径（多 token 并行生成），prefill 专指 KV cache 预计算（`precompute_and_store_context_kv`）。
checkpoints: 检查 graph bucket 命名是否准确反映其语义
确认 prefill/decode 的使用场景与命名一致

pattern.code:
class AscendDFlashSpeculator:
    """DFlash speculator for Ascend NPU with FullGraph support."""

    def __init__(self, ...):
        ...
        self.draft_attn_layer_names = [...]

    # NOTE: Named to follow vllm upstream convention.
    # If vllm renames this function, update here accordingly.
    def _build_draft_attn_metadatas(self, attn_metadata):
        """Build draft attention metadatas from the full attention metadata.

        Note: This function filters the attention metadata to only include
        the draft attention layers used by the DFlash speculator.
        """
        attn_metadata = {
            name: metadata
            for name, metadata in attn_metadata.items()
            if name in self.draft_attn_layer_names
        }
        return attn_metadata

    def run_fullgraph(self, ...):
        """Run the full graph for draft token generation."""
        ...
        draft_attn_metadatas = self._build_draft_attn_metadatas(
            self.model_state.attn_metadata)
        ...
